nodes.label: csResendRFQ - POST /pr/cs/resend-rfq/{rfq_number}/{vendor_batch}
nodes.rationale: Manual CS resend of the RFQ email when a vendor has not confirmed receipt. The description explicitly cites a sibling operation: 'Same as /email/resend-request-for-quotation but requires BearerAuth instead of path parameters' - i.e. the duplication exists deliberately so the authenticated CS console can trigger the same send without exposing the unauthenticated email-token route. Empty request body.

edges.source_location: description: resend if vendor hasn't confirmed receipt
